physicalNotes: No radius or mass of MACS J0717 is recorded here: its package frames it at 1,444,888 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), MACS J0717.5+3745: position from 2011MNRAS.410.1939Z, redshift from 2025A&A...703A.306D (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=MACS%20J0717.5%2B3745); NED preferred values of MACS J0717.5+3745: RA 109.3788625°, Dec 37.75826111° (2011MNRAS.410.1939Z); redshift 0.549 (2025A&A...703A.306D)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 0.549 (NED, 2025A&A...703A.306D) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 2108633877.0901115 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209).
